name: splat-transform
role: CLI and JavaScript library for processing and converting 3D Gaussian splats
notes: 2026-11-15: Assess because the digest identifies a conversion and filtering gap between splat producers and mesh-only tools. Revisit after confirming the official automation interface and supported formats.
summary: Node.js CLI and library for transforming and converting Gaussian splat assets. It handles splat-oriented workflows directly, including conversion and filtering, where general mesh tools do not preserve splat data.
use_when: Convert or filter Gaussian splat assets in a scriptable pipeline
Choose a splat-native processor over mesh-only tools
avoid_when: Use Blender for general mesh modelling or scene rendering
Use a splat viewer when you only need interactive inspection

install.macos: in examples/splat-transform-convert: pnpm add @playcanvas/splat-transform@3.12.0 (project-local exact pin; no global install)

assessment.rationale: Official release page shows v3.6.6 on 2026-09-25; the project documents CLI and library use for splat conversion and processing. Distinct from mesh tools.
